replies.author: @jasminthomas3528
replies.text: ​@BestTravelDocumentary4k   The roti, we have a variety of them. Our favourite street food is doubles, which is two baras with curried channa and hot sauces in the middle. Our food is heavily influenced by our East Indian and West African ancestry. Added to the mix are French, Spanish, Portuguese, Chinese and Syrian. We're a melting pot of food, culture, religion and music. I grew up  with my maternal grandmother who was Hindu and visited my paternal grandparents who were Muslim. I was exposed to all the religious celebrations and foods. Mauritius seems to have the same ethos and harmony that I remember from home. I love it.

replies.author: @BestTravelDocumentary4k
replies.text: "That is the absolute beauty of human connection—discovering home in unexpected places around the world! 🇹🇹🏴󠁧󠁢󠁷󠁬󠁳󠁿 What was the specific dish or custom in the video that instantly reminded you of Trinidad?"
